import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify highly correlated pairs (|r| >= 0.6)
    corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    mask = np.abs(corr) >= 0.6
    np.fill_diagonal(mask, False)
    
    # Find connected components in correlation graph
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(
        n_clusters=None, 
        distance_threshold=1-0.6,
        linkage='complete',
        connectivity=mask
    )
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(np.eye(len(feats.ids)))
    
    # Select cluster with highest mean effect size
    best_cluster = None
    best_effect = -np.inf
    
    for i in set(clusters):
        cluster_ids = [feats.ids[j] for j in range(len(feats.ids)) if clusters[j] == i]
        if len(cluster_ids) < 2:
            continue
            
        # Compute mean effect size (absolute difference in means)
        cluster_cols = [feats.column(fid) for fid in cluster_ids]
        x_cluster = feats.x[:, cluster_cols]
        effects = [abs(np.mean(x_cluster[feats.y==1, j]) - np.mean(x_cluster[feats.y==0, j])) 
                   for j in range(len(cluster_ids))]
        mean_effect = np.mean(effects)
        
        if mean_effect > best_effect:
            best_effect = mean_effect
            best_cluster = cluster_ids
    
    # If no strong cluster found, return empty design
    if best_cluster is None:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Create weighted score from best cluster
    cluster_cols = [feats.column(fid) for fid in best_cluster]
    x_cluster = feats.x[:, cluster_cols]
    
    # Weight by effect sizes (standardized differences)
    weights = np.array([
        abs(np.mean(x_cluster[feats.y==1, j]) - np.mean(x_cluster[feats.y==0, j]))
        for j in range(len(cluster_cols))
    ])
    weights = weights / np.sum(weights)  # Normalize
    
    # Return design with drivers, columns, products, and loadings
    return Design(
        drivers=(best_cluster[0],),  # Most influential feature as driver
        columns=tuple(best_cluster),
        products=(),
        loadings=dict(zip(best_cluster, weights))
    )
